question: Until what point should singing in Gauḍa, Bhāsa, and other styles continue?
premises: The singing uses Gauḍa, Bhāsa, and other styles
The performance continues until the end of the incense offering
inference: After that, one should perform singing in Gauḍa, Bhāsa, and other styles until the end of the incense offering.
uncertainties: The precise identification of gauḍa and bhāsa as musical forms is context-dependent.
plain_english: After that, one should perform singing in Gauḍa, Bhāsa, and other styles until the end of the incense offering.
